row.evidence: NotaryCam's pricing, licensing and API pages mention team collaboration and an API for creating users, but no page reachable without login mentions SSO, SAML or SCIM; the support centre requires a login.
row.notes: New in September 2026. Pricing is per transaction (Notarize Now $25 per seal, real-estate closings from $199) or software licensing: independent notaries $15/mo (billed monthly) for 1 seat plus $99 onboarding and per-transaction fees; Team and Enterprise licences (unlimited seats, API access) are Contact Sales. No SSO, SAML or SCIM is mentioned on the pricing, licensing, custom-solutions, security or FAQ pages, and the API V4 overview lists Authentication, Users, Transactions and other groups but no SCIM. The help centre (support.notarycam.com, Freshdesk) is login-only, so 'none' by absence cannot be claimed (rule 5); status stays unknown. Not in the Okta OIN or Entra gallery.
